moments.title: Premier League Kicks Off
moments.blurb: The 2026/27 Premier League season officially begins next Friday, with defending champions Arsenal hosting newly promoted Coventry City in the opening fixture.

angles.name: Opening Match Buzz
angles.copy: Football is back! The Premier League season kicks off next Friday with Arsenal vs Coventry City. Who are you backing for the title this year?

angles.name: Coventry's Return
angles.copy: A huge welcome back to the Premier League for Coventry City! Kicking off their campaign against the champions, Arsenal, next Friday. What a start!

moments.title: EFL Championship Season Begins
moments.blurb: The 2026-27 EFL Championship season gets underway tomorrow, August 14, with Wolverhampton Wanderers taking on Blackburn Rovers, while Wrexham faces Cardiff City on Monday.

angles.name: Championship Kicks Off
angles.copy: The Championship is back! The 2026-27 season starts tomorrow, August 14. Who are you tipping for promotion this year?

angles.name: Wrexham's Big Opener
angles.copy: All eyes on Wrexham as they kick off their Championship campaign against Cardiff City on Monday! A huge Welsh derby to start the season.

moments.title: Community Shield in Cardiff
moments.blurb: Manchester City and Arsenal will battle it out for the Community Shield this Sunday, August 16, at Principality Stadium in Cardiff.

angles.name: Cardiff Hosts Community Shield
angles.copy: Cardiff takes centre stage this Sunday as Principality Stadium hosts the Community Shield between Man City and Arsenal! Who's lifting the first silverware of the season?

angles.name: City vs Arsenal
angles.copy: A taste of the Premier League rivalry early! Manchester City face Arsenal in the Community Shield on Sunday. Get ready for some football action!

moments.title: The Hundred Finals Day
moments.blurb: The Hundred cricket tournament culminates this Sunday, August 16, with Finals Day at Lord's, where both the men's and women's champions will be crowned.

angles.name: Cricket Finals Day
angles.copy: It's Finals Day for The Hundred this Sunday at Lord's! Who are you hoping to see crowned champions of the men's and women's tournaments?

angles.name: Lord's Hosts Finals
angles.copy: All roads lead to Lord's this Sunday for The Hundred Finals Day! Get ready for a day of explosive cricket action.

moments.title: Palace Bowl Presents: Final Weekend
moments.blurb: The 'Palace Bowl Presents' series at Crystal Palace Bowl in London concludes this weekend, with Bastille and The Wombats among the acts performing until August 16.

angles.name: Last Chance for Palace Bowl
angles.copy: Catch Bastille and The Wombats at the Crystal Palace Bowl this weekend as 'Palace Bowl Presents' wraps up! Don't miss out on these London summer gigs.

angles.name: Who's at Crystal Palace?
angles.copy: What a line-up at Crystal Palace Bowl this week! Bastille and The Wombats are bringing the tunes. Who are you heading to see before Sunday?

moments.title: We Out Here Festival Next Week
moments.blurb: We Out Here Festival, celebrating genre-hopping music, returns to Wimborne St Giles, Dorset, from August 20-23, though tickets are now sold out.

angles.name: We Out Here Sold Out
angles.copy: We Out Here Festival is officially SOLD OUT for next week! If you were lucky enough to grab tickets, get ready for a fantastic four days of music in Dorset.

angles.name: Festival Countdown
angles.copy: Just one week until We Out Here Festival takes over Dorset! Celebrating jazz, club culture, and more. Who's heading down?

moments.title: Creamfields Two Weeks Away
moments.blurb: The UK's largest electronic music festival, Creamfields, is just two weeks away, taking place from August 27-30 in Daresbury, Cheshire.

angles.name: Creamfields Countdown
angles.copy: The countdown is on! Just two weeks until Creamfields takes over Daresbury. Who's ready for four days of the best electronic music?

angles.name: Line-up Excitement
angles.copy: Creamfields is almost here! With Calvin Harris, Swedish House Mafia, Tiësto and more, it's set to be massive. What acts are you buzzing to see?

moments.title: Reading & Leeds Festival Soon
moments.blurb: Reading & Leeds Festival, one of the UK's biggest music events, is set to take place from August 28-30, promising a huge weekend of rock, indie, and pop.

angles.name: Reading & Leeds Excitement
angles.copy: Who's ready for Reading & Leeds Festival at the end of the month? Get your tents and wellies ready for an epic weekend!

angles.name: Festival Buzz
angles.copy: The buzz is building for Reading & Leeds! Three days of incredible music are just around the corner. What acts are you desperate to catch?

moments.title: Victorious Festival Nears
moments.blurb: Portsmouth's Victorious Festival, known for its beautiful location and diverse line-up, is set for August 28-30.

angles.name: Portsmouth's Big Weekend
angles.copy: Victorious Festival is almost here! Three days of amazing music by the sea in Portsmouth, August 28-30. Who's heading to the south coast?

moments.title: Strictly Come Dancing Returns
moments.blurb: Strictly Come Dancing is set to return for its 24th series, with the launch show airing on September 19 and live shows commencing September 26, featuring new hosts Emma Willis, Josh Widdicombe, and Johannes Radebe.

angles.name: Strictly's New Era
angles.copy: Get ready for glitter and glamour! Strictly Come Dancing is back next month with new hosts Emma Willis, Josh Widdicombe, and Johannes Radebe. The launch show is September 19!

angles.name: Who's Excited for Strictly?
angles.copy: Strictly Come Dancing is almost here! The launch show on September 19 will reveal this year's pairings. Who are you excited to see on the dancefloor?

moments.title: Happy 42nd Birthday James Morrison
moments.blurb: English singer-songwriter James Morrison, known for hits like 'You Give Me Something,' turns 42 today.

angles.name: Birthday Shoutout James Morrison
angles.copy: Wishing a very Happy 42nd Birthday to the incredible James Morrison! Still love 'You Give Me Something' and his amazing husky vocals.

angles.name: James Morrison's Music
angles.copy: From 'Undiscovered' to 'Broken Strings', James Morrison has given us so many great tracks. Happy 42nd Birthday to a true talent!

moments.title: Happy 27th Birthday Lennon Stella
moments.blurb: Canadian singer and actress Lennon Stella, known for her role in 'Nashville' and her soulful pop music, celebrates her 27th birthday today.

angles.name: Birthday Lennon Stella
angles.copy: Happy 27th Birthday to the talented Lennon Stella! From 'Nashville' to her stunning solo music, she's a star.

angles.name: Lennon Stella's Music
angles.copy: Listening to Lennon Stella's 'Three. Two. One.' today to celebrate her 27th Birthday! What's your favourite track?

moments.title: Happy 67th Birthday Feargal Sharkey
moments.blurb: Feargal Sharkey, lead singer of The Undertones and solo artist known for 'A Good Heart,' celebrates his 67th birthday today.

angles.name: Feargal Sharkey Birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a very Happy 67th Birthday to the legendary Feargal Sharkey! From The Undertones to 'A Good Heart', what a career.

angles.name: A Good Heart
angles.copy: Still got 'A Good Heart' on repeat! Happy 67th Birthday to Feargal Sharkey, whose voice is simply iconic.

moments.title: UK Heatwave Peaks Today
moments.blurb: The UK has recorded its hottest day of the year today, August 13, with temperatures reaching 38.1°C in London, making it the fifth hottest day on record.

angles.name: Hottest Day Alert
angles.copy: Phew, what a scorcher! The UK has seen its hottest day of the year today, with 38.1°C recorded in London. Stay cool and hydrated everyone!

angles.name: Heatwave Records
angles.copy: Today marks the fifth hottest day on record for the UK, with temperatures hitting 38.1°C. This summer is certainly one for the history books!

moments.title: August Bank Holiday Approaching
moments.blurb: The late August Bank Holiday for England, Wales, and Northern Ireland is just over two weeks away, falling on Monday, August 31, 2026.

angles.name: Bank Holiday Countdown
angles.copy: Hands up if you're already counting down to the August Bank Holiday! Just over two weeks until that glorious long weekend. What are your plans?

angles.name: Summer's Last Hurrah
angles.copy: The Late Summer Bank Holiday is on August 31st for England, Wales, and Northern Ireland. The perfect excuse for a final summer escape!
